# Rule 1.6 You are expected to respect other players' consent settings at all times. If another player voices in LOOC/OOC chat that they are uncomfortable with a situation, you are expected to immediately stop what you are doing. If this behavior is continued, you may be subjected to punishment. Violation of this rule may result in an immediate ban, with the ban type depending on severity.
• If you desire to involve yourself in others' ERP, assuming it is in a semi-private place, you are allowed to ask to join them via LOOC, however, if they decline, you MUST leave the area immediately thereafter, and you may NOT act on whatever you saw there. 

• If you are ERPing in a department-specific, public area, and someone from said department asks you to leave, you are expected to do so 

• Before engaging in sexual activities with someone, you must make sure the person is willing to engage in such actions. 

• Afterlight is an Erotic Roleplay Environment. You WILL see nudity, sexual acts and adult content either visually and/or mechanically. There are some types of content you’ll be exposed to regardless of your kinks or preferences due to the nature of this station.
## Rules about the noncon pref: • If your non-con preferences are set to 'Yes', you waive your right to fight back against your would-be non-consensual roleplay partners, as long as they don’t violate the contents of your OOC notes, or you speak up in LOOC against what they are doing to you. 

• All non-con actions are considered non-canon to the round when performed if perpetrated by non-antags. You are not to call for help over comms over being non-conned, unless all parties agree to the consequences of such actions, as doing so consistently results in a witch hunt against your roleplay partner. And the CONSEQUENCES and effect on the round of your ERP should only be decided upon AFTER your scene has been completed, and all parties should consent to them.
